name.ja: HG 1/24 霊子戦闘機・無限(東雲初穂機)
name.en: HG 1/24 Reiko Fighter Mugen (Shinonome Hatsuho Machine)

description.ja: 『新サクラ大戦』より、「霊子戦闘機・無限（東雲初穂機）」が参戦！
description.en: From "New Sakura Wars ", " Reiko Fighter Mugen (Shinonome Hatsuho Machine)" joins the battle!

description.ja: ■劇中で印象的なコックピットハッチの開閉を再現。搭乗姿の東雲初穂のフィギュアが付属。
description.en: • Reproduces the impressive opening and closing of the cockpit hatch in the movie. A figure of Hatsuho Shinonome in her riding form is included.

description.ja: ■コックピット内部も設定に忠実に再現。
description.en: • The interior of the cockpit is also faithfully reproduced.

description.ja: ■手・足の関節部分に伸縮を可能とする延長ギミックを搭載。アクションポーズの幅が広がる。
description.en: • Equipped with an extension gimmick that allows the joints of the hands and feet to expand and contract. Expands the range of action poses.

description.ja: ■初穂機の特徴的な武装である巨大なハンマーが付属。
description.en: • Comes with Hatsuho's characteristic armament, a huge hammer.
